phase1.code:
# Interactive plots with Plotly

print("=== Plotly — Interactive Visualizations ===\n")

print("Plotly creates interactive plots with:")
print("  ✅ Zoom and pan")
print("  ✅ Hover information")
print("  ✅ Click interactions")
print("  ✅ Export capabilities")
print("  ✅ Web-based")

print("\n=== Basic Plotly Example (Code) ===\n")

print("""
import plotly.express as px
import pandas as pd

# Create data
df = pd.DataFrame({
    'x': [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    'y': [10, 15, 7, 20, 12],
    'label': ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E']
})

# Line plot
fig = px.line(df, x='x', y='y', title='Interactive Line Plot')
fig.show()
""")

print("\n=== Scatter Plot with Hover ===\n")

print("""
import plotly.express as px

# Create data
df = px.data.iris()

# Scatter plot with color
fig = px.scatter(df, x='sepal_width', y='sepal_length',
                 color='species', size='petal_length',
                 hover_data=['petal_width'],
                 title='Iris Dataset')
fig.show()
""")

print("\n=== Bar Chart ===\n")

print("""
import plotly.express as px

# Data
categories = ['Warrior', 'Mage', 'Rogue', 'Archer']
counts = [45, 38, 42, 35]

df = pd.DataFrame({'Class': categories, 'Count': counts})

# Bar chart
fig = px.bar(df, x='Class', y='Count',
             title='Class Distribution',
             color='Class')
fig.show()
""")

print("\n=== 3D Scatter Plot ===\n")

print("""
import plotly.express as px

# Data
df = px.data.iris()

# 3D scatter
fig = px.scatter_3d(df, x='sepal_length', y='sepal_width', z='petal_length',
                    color='species', size='petal_width',
                    title='3D Iris Visualization')
fig.show()
""")

print("\n=== Heatmap ===\n")

print("""
import plotly.express as px
import numpy as np

# Correlation matrix
corr = df.corr()

# Heatmap
fig = px.imshow(corr, text_auto=True,
                title='Correlation Heatmap')
fig.show()
""")

print("\n=== Plotly vs Matplotlib ===\n")

print("Plotly advantages:")
print("  ✅ Interactive")
print("  ✅ Web-friendly")
print("  ✅ Better for presentations")
print("  ✅ Built-in hover info")

print("\nMatplotlib advantages:")
print("  ✅ More control")
print("  ✅ Static output")
print("  ✅ Faster for large datasets")
print("  ✅ Works offline")

print("\n=== Installing Plotly ===\n")

print("To install Plotly:")
print("  pip install plotly")
print("  conda install plotly")

print("\n=== Exporting Plotly Charts ===\n")

print("Export options:")
print("  fig.write_html('plot.html')  # Web page")
print("  fig.write_image('plot.png')  # Image (requires kaleido)")
print("  fig.write_json('plot.json')   # JSON format")

phase1.explanation:
🐍 **Plotly creates interactive visualizations.**

**Plotly Express (high-level):**
```python
import plotly.express as px

# Line plot
fig = px.line(df, x='date', y='value')

# Scatter plot
fig = px.scatter(df, x='x', y='y', color='category')

# Bar chart
fig = px.bar(df, x='category', y='value')

# Histogram
fig = px.histogram(df, x='value')

# 3D scatter
fig = px.scatter_3d(df, x='x', y='y', z='z', color='category')
```

**Plotly Graph Objects (low-level):**
```python
import plotly.graph_objects as go

fig = go.Figure()
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=x, y=y, mode='lines'))
fig.update_layout(title='Title')
```

**Key features:**
- **Hover info** — See data points on hover
- **Zoom/Pan** — Explore interactively
- **Export** — Save as HTML, PNG, or JSON
- **Customization** — Complete control

**Python-chan says:**
"Plotly makes your visualizations interactive. Perfect for presentations and web applications."
